<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Receive a quantity against a line"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/receipts/{receiptId}/lines"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records `quantity` units of line `lineNo` as `Good` or `Damaged` and
publishes `ReceiptLineReceived` (the handover event: inventory-storage
books the Good ones). This is NOT naturally idempotent, so the
`Idempotency-Key` is required: a retry with the same key never counts
the units twice. Over-receipt is accepted and shows as an `Over`
discrepancy on close. Receiving into a `Closed` receipt is 409
`receipt-closed`; a `lineNo` the ASN does not have is 422
`line-not-on-asn`.
